entities.summary: Thomas Terry Connally was an American politician who represented Texas in both the U.S. Senate and the U.S. House of Representatives as a member of the Democratic Party. He served in the U.S. House of Representatives from 1917 to 1929, and in the U.S. Senate from 1929 to 1953.
